decision.reasoning_trace: My goal was to find a reliable, portable Bluetooth speaker with strong battery life and brand trust. I evaluated a variety of options. The Sony SRS-XB43 is high quality but too heavy for easy travel and relatively expensive. The Ultimate Ears Megablast is also high-priced and has several reviews highlighting software issues and poor Alexa integration. Within the more portable segment, the JBL Go 3 is well-rated but its 5-hour battery life is insufficient for my needs. The Raymate offers interesting specs for the price, but as a lesser-known brand, I am hesitant about its actual performance and durability. Lastly, the JBL Clip 3 is a renewed product, and I would prefer a new unit to ensure the battery is at full health. Since none of the speakers perfectly balanced my requirements for brand reliability, battery life, and portability, I decided not to make a purchase.
